title: Trôi trong đêm
about: Round x2 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian): floating, with more of a tune than the others. The glass plays a slow, whole melody over the pad, a low bell answering its long notes; soft high glass shimmering on the chords. F minor at 54 bpm. An original piece.
